concerns.text: SC‑001 (precision difference measurement against a hypothesis‑driven bound) is not referenced by any task; no checklist item creates or validates this comparison.
SC‑002 (latency reduction measurement against baseline latency) lacks a dedicated task; while latency is logged, no task explicitly computes or asserts the required reduction.
SC‑003 (token‑consumption variance measurement against baseline) is absent from the task list; no task records or analyses token‑variance as required.
The plan specifies a `quickstart.md` deliverable, but no task creates or validates this document.
The data model includes `ground_truth_annotations.csv`, yet no task explicitly generates this file; downstream tasks (e.g., T011) assume its existence.

SC‑005 (statistical significance against a deferred threshold) is only partially covered; tasks perform a test and output a p‑value but never compare it to the deferred significance level, leaving the success criterion untested.
